versos.grego: Πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ γεγέννηται, καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν γεννήσαντα ἀγαπᾷ τὸν γεγεννημένον ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
controles.kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
controles.livre: Todo aquele que crê que Jesus é o Cristo é nascido de Deus; e todo aquele que ama ao que gerou, também ama ao que dele é nascido.

versos.grego: ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἀγαπῶμεν τὰ τέκνα τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὅταν τὸν Θεὸν ἀγαπῶμεν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ποιῶμεν.

controles.web: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
controles.kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
controles.livre: Nisto sabemos que amamos os filhos de Deus: quando amamos a Deus, e praticamos os seus mandamentos.

versos.grego: αὕτη γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἵνα τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν· καὶ αἱ ἐντολαὶ αὐτοῦ βαρεῖαι οὐκ εἰσίν,

controles.web: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
controles.kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
controles.livre: Pois este é o amor de Deus: que guardemos os seus mandamentos. E os seus mandamentos não são pesados.

versos.grego: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ νικᾷ τὸν κόσμον· καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ νίκη ἡ νικήσασα τὸν κόσμον, ἡ πίστις ἡμῶν.

controles.web: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
controles.kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
controles.livre: Pois todo aquele que é nascido de Deus vence o mundo; e esta é a vitória que vence o mundo: a nossa fé.

versos.grego: τίς ἐστιν ὁ νικῶν τὸν κόσμον εἰ μὴ ὁ πιστεύων ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ;

controles.web: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
controles.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
controles.livre: Quem é o que vence o mundo, senão aquele que crê que Jesus é o Filho de Deus?

versos.grego: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἐλθὼν δι’ ὕδατος καὶ αἵματος, Ἰησοῦς Χριστός· οὐκ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι μόνον, ἀλλ’ ἐν τῷ ὕδατι καὶ ἐν τῷ αἵματι· καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ μαρτυροῦν, ὅτι τὸ Πνεῦμά ἐστιν ἡ ἀλήθεια.

controles.web: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
controles.kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
controles.livre: Este é aquele que veio por água e sangue: Jesus, o Cristo. Não só pela água, mas pela água e pelo sangue. E o Espírito é o que lhe dá testemunho, porque o Espírito é a verdade.

versos.grego: ὅτι τρεῖς εἰσιν οἱ μαρτυροῦντες,

controles.web: For there are three who testify:
controles.kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
controles.livre: Pois são três os que dão testemunho:

versos.grego: τὸ Πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ τὸ αἷμα, καὶ οἱ τρεῖς εἰς τὸ ἕν εἰσιν.

controles.web: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
controles.kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
controles.livre: o Espírito, a água e o sangue; e estes três estão em unidade.

versos.grego: εἰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων λαμβάνομεν, ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Θεοῦ μείζων ἐστίν, ὅτι αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι μεμαρτύρηκεν περὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
controles.kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
controles.livre: Se recebemos o testemunho humano, o testemunho de Deus é maior; pois este é o testemunho de Deus, que testificou de seu Filho.

versos.grego: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔχει τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐν αὑτῷ. ὁ μὴ πιστεύων τῷ Θεῷ ψεύστην πεποίηκεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὐ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἣν μεμαρτύρηκεν ὁ Θεὸς περὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
controles.kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
controles.livre: Quem crê no Filho de Deus tem testemunho em si; quem não crê em Deus o fez de mentiroso, porque não creu no testemunho que Deus deu acerca do seu Filho.

versos.grego: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ μαρτυρία, ὅτι ζωὴν αἰώνιον ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῖν, καὶ αὕτη ἡ ζωὴ ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.

controles.web: The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
controles.kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
controles.livre: E este é o testemunho: que Deus nos deu a vida eterna; e essa vida está no seu Filho.

versos.grego: ὁ ἔχων τὸν Υἱὸν ἔχει τὴν ζωήν· ὁ μὴ ἔχων τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν ζωὴν οὐκ ἔχει.

controles.web: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
controles.kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
controles.livre: Quem tem o Filho tem a vida; quem não tem o Filho de Deus não tem a vida.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἵνα εἰδῆτε ὅτι ζωὴν ἔχετε αἰώνιον, τοῖς πιστεύουσιν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
controles.kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
controles.livre: Estas coisas escrevi para vós que credes no nome do Filho de Deus, para que saibais que tendes a vida eterna.

versos.grego: Καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ παρρησία ἣν ἔχομεν πρὸς αὐτόν, ὅτι ἐάν τι αἰτώμεθα κατὰ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ἀκούει ἡμῶν.

controles.web: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
controles.kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
controles.livre: E esta é a confiança que diante dele: que se pedirmos alguma coisa conforme a sua vontade, ele nos ouve.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀκούει ἡμῶν ὃ ἐὰν αἰτώμεθα, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἔχομεν τὰ αἰτήματα ἃ ᾐτήκαμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
controles.kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
controles.livre: E se sabemos que nos ouve em tudo o que pedimos, sabemos que alcançamos as coisas que lhe pedimos.

versos.grego: Ἐάν τις ἴδῃ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτάνοντα ἁμαρτίαν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον, αἰτήσει, καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ ζωήν, τοῖς ἁμαρτάνουσιν μὴ πρὸς θάνατον. ἔστιν ἁμαρτία πρὸς θάνατον· οὐ περὶ ἐκείνης λέγω ἵνα ἐρωτήσῃ.

controles.web: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is a sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
controles.kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
controles.livre: Se alguém vê o seu irmão cometer um pecado que não é para a morte, orará, e lhe dará vida, para os que não pecarem para a morte. Há pecado para a morte, pelo qual não digo que ore.

versos.grego: πᾶσα ἀδικία ἁμαρτία ἐστίν, καὶ ἔστιν ἁμαρτία οὐ πρὸς θάνατον.

controles.web: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is a sin not leading to death.
controles.kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
controles.livre: Toda injustiça é pecado; e há pecado que não é para a morte.

versos.grego: Οἴδαμεν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει, ἀλλ’ ὁ γεννηθεὶς ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ τηρεῖ αὐτόν, καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς οὐχ ἅπτεται αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
controles.kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
controles.livre: Sabemos que todo aquele que é nascido de Deus não pratica o pecado; mas o que é gerado de Deus o guarda,  e o maligno não o toca.

versos.grego: οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐσμεν, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ὅλος ἐν τῷ πονηρῷ κεῖται.

controles.web: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
controles.kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
controles.livre: Sabemos que somos de Deus, e que o mundo todo jaz no maligno.

versos.grego: οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἥκει, καὶ δέδωκεν ἡμῖν διάνοιαν ἵνα γινώσκομεν τὸν ἀληθινόν· καὶ ἐσμὲν ἐν τῷ ἀληθινῷ, ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ. οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀληθινὸς Θεὸς καὶ ζωὴ αἰώνιος.

controles.web: We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
controles.kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
controles.livre: E sabemos que o Filho de Deus veio, e nos deu entendimento para conhecermos o Verdadeiro; e no Verdadeiro estamos, em seu Filho Jesus Cristo. Este é o verdadeiro Deus, e a vida eterna.

versos.grego: Τεκνία, φυλάξατε ἑαυτὰ ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων.

controles.web: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
controles.kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
controles.livre: Filhinhos, guardai-vos dos ídolos.
